name: Sync Ohalo Classifications (Interactive)
description: Interactive variant of the Sync Ohalo Classifications workflow. Started from Collibra's global Create menu: confirms the action on a start form, runs the same Ohalo-to-Collibra sync (classifications, annotators, extractors, labels), then shows a results form with per-category counts and any failures. All connection settings (Ohalo URL, auth token, domain and asset/attribute type IDs) remain hidden admin configuration on the workflow settings page.
